# F16

Seed 2026101016; exactly 10000 calls to random.Random(seed).uniform(-10,10), in generation order, with E12 Φ per point. No filtering or redraws.

These are function-vector fixtures, not return series, and use an explicit phi-input schema. compute reproduces their expected point arrays; phi-points.json / phi-vector.json provide the same points for the engine's function tests. They do not invoke a statistics sample refusal.
